title: Focus & Cleft Structures
goal: Use cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'fue... quien/donde' to emphasize specific information in complex speech.

sections.title: Unit 1: Nuance, Precision & Emphasis
body: Welcome to Spanish B2 Core. At this level you move from reporting facts to shaping perspective, controlling emphasis and building nuanced arguments.

In this first unit you will learn the tools that skilled speakers use to direct attention: cleft sentences ('lo que realmente importa es...'), stance and focus adverbs ('francamente', 'en rigor'), fronting with inversion, and contrastive focus with 'no ... sino'.

items: Build cleft sentences with 'lo que' and 'ser' to spotlight an idea.
Spotlight a person, a place or a time with 'fue ... quien / donde / cuando'.
Choose the cleft sentence that answers the question I was asked.
Use the lesson's words to talk about emphasis and background.
